test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Union Finance Minister, on 9 November 2024, inaugurated Nari Shakti Branches of which of the following banks in Bengaluru, Chennai, Visakhapatnam, and Jaipur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Union Finance Minister inaugurated Nari Shakti Branches of Union Bank of India on 9 November 2024.
 
• The branches are located in Bengaluru, Chennai, Visakhapatnam, and Jaipur.
 
• Nari Shakti Branches aim to empower women by providing specialized banking services.
 
• The initiative is part of the bank's efforts to promote financial inclusion among women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Financial Inclusion:**

 
 
• Financial inclusion refers to making financial services accessible and affordable to all individuals, especially those underserved by the banking sector.
 
• It aims to ensure that everyone has access to basic financial services like savings, credit, insurance, and pensions.
 
• Financial inclusion is crucial for reducing poverty and fostering economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Women Empowerment:**
 
 
• Women empowerment involves creating an environment where women can make independent decisions for their personal development.
 
• It includes providing access to education, employment, and financial services.
 
• Empowered women contribute significantly to the economic and social development of their communities.
 
 
 
• **Union Bank of India:**
 
 
• Union Bank of India is one of the largest government-owned banks in India.
 
• It was established in 1919 and has its headquarters in Mumbai.
 
• The bank provides a wide range of banking and financial services to its customers.
